description: This file defines RAII classes for managing CUDA streams and devices, including InlineStreamGuard, InlineOptionalStreamGuard, and InlineMultiStreamGuard, used for stream and device management in CUDA programming within the c10::impl namespace.

classes.name: InlineStreamGuard
classes.description: RAII class that manages CUDA stream and device switching, ensuring proper restoration on destruction.

classes.name: InlineOptionalStreamGuard
classes.description: RAII class that manages an optional CUDA stream and device, allowing for conditional stream management.

classes.name: InlineMultiStreamGuard
classes.description: RAII class that manages multiple CUDA streams across different devices, restoring original streams on destruction.

methods.name: reset_stream
methods.description: Resets the current stream to a new stream, updating device and stream states accordingly.

methods.name: original_stream
methods.description: Returns the original stream of the device prior to guard activation.

methods.name: current_stream
methods.description: Returns the most recently set stream managed by the guard.

methods.name: current_device
methods.description: Returns the current device managed by the guard.

methods.name: original_device
methods.description: Returns the original device prior to guard activation.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the optional stream guard to an uninitialized state.
